name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban / Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Rural Development
benefit_summary: Direct construction grant of ₹1.2 to ₹2.5 Lakhs (Gramin) or interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans (CLSS) up to ₹2.67 Lakhs for pucca house construction.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban / Gramin) guidelines.
required_documents: Photographs of existing kutcha house / site
Affidavit of no pucca house ownership
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
